source_instruction: i'm looking for high waisted denim shorts distressed jeans for women.
query:
Oh man, you’ll never guess what happened on my walk over to the store today! I cut through that little community park a couple blocks over, right where they planted all those native wildflowers along the walking path last spring, and I stopped for a second to watch a fluffy calico cat perched on the top slat of a park bench. It was batting so intently at a monarch butterfly fluttering just out of reach that it didn’t even notice when a tiny toddler waddled up behind it holding a half-eaten cheese cracker, and the second the cat turned around it got so spooked it toppled straight off the bench into a patch of clover. I laughed so hard I had to lean against a nearby oak tree for a minute, and I ended up chatting with the toddler’s mom for a bit while the kid tried to offer the cat a crumb of the cracker, even though the cat was now hiding under the bench pretending it didn’t just face-plant in front of total strangers.
Hey, can you help me find women’s shorts in this section? I need ones with Velcro closure, slim fit, that usual size I always grab, and I also want them to come with a detachable woven belt, all for under $20. I’ve been wandering the racks for ten minutes and can’t spot anything that checks all my boxes, so I’d really appreciate the help narrowing it down.
